svg.title: DownBlock and UpBlock internals
svg.desc: The matching DownBlock 1 and UpBlock 1 from the training configuration, with three residual blocks per level and linear attention. Read DownBlock downward and UpBlock upward. DownBlock takes [B,32,35], runs residual1, saves first_residual, runs residual2 and attention, then extra_blocks[0], which runs another residual layer and attention. It saves final_features and downsamples with a kernel-4 stride-2 convolution to [B,64,17]. Each saved skip is [B,32,35]. After the deeper blocks, UpBlock receives [B,64,35]. It matches length and concatenates final_features first, producing [B,96,35], then residual1 reduces it to [B,64,35]. It next matches length and concatenates first_residual, again producing [B,96,35], and residual2 reduces it to [B,64,35]. Attention and extra_blocks[0] follow. Nearest-neighbor resizing and a kernel-3 convolution output [B,32,70]. Each residual layer receives the timestep embedding tau and the per-level condition c1. The first saved skip therefore enters the second decoder residual layer; the final saved skip enters the first. Tensor dimensions are batch, channels, length. Other levels use different channel counts and lengths. The deepest DownBlock and last UpBlock use convolution without changing sequence length.
